recipe.title: Send an email to someone
recipe.useCase: Send a message from the connected Gmail account, with a draft-first path when the send needs a second look.

difficulty.reason: One required call, but a sent message cannot be recalled.

steps.instruction: Confirm the recipients, subject, body and attachments, and whether to send now or draft first, before the irreversible send.

steps.condition: A sender other than the default address or alias is needed.
steps.instruction: Set the from field to the alias the account is allowed to send as.

steps.condition: send_email fails validation, or a safer retry is wanted.
steps.instruction: Create a draft with the same recipients, subject and body.
Send the draft by its draft id once it reads right.

steps.condition: The caller wants proof that the message went out.
steps.instruction: Fetch the message by the id the send returned and check its labels.

pitfalls.text: Sending is not idempotent: a retry sends a second copy.
pitfalls.fix: Check the sent mail before sending again.

pitfalls.text: A send with no recipients, or with neither subject nor body, is refused.
pitfalls.fix: Fill in at least one recipient and a subject or body.

pitfalls.text: The connected account is the wrong one or lacks the send scope.
pitfalls.fix: Connect the right account with the send scope.

pitfalls.text: A success returns ids only, not the message.
pitfalls.fix: Read the message back with gmail.get_message when the content matters.

pitfalls.text: A draft id is not a message id.
pitfalls.fix: Send a draft with gmail.send_draft, not gmail.get_message.
